scope: Exact Psalm 91 / 11Q11 published and private-transcription comparison, source/restoration boundaries and current POB/Swete controls only
actual_source_checks: Lawful Lexham 2010 preview read directly: VI.3–9 only, stopping at beginning of verse 10; reported letters are the edition's transcription, not independent scroll-pixel readings.
Actual Qumran-Digital 2026-05-21 page checked: section 6 stops at preceding composition's line 3; its digital-content gap is not a physical lacuna and it is not QDR.
Pinned private QDR surface words[][1] VI.3–14 checked with restoration spans across word boundaries; later verses remain expressly provisional QDR-only beyond the preview.

Swete II printed 336–337 / PDF354–355 visually inspected including apparatus: third-person speech in v2, darkness/noon order, no speech verb v9, base omits all in v11 while apparatus adds it, two snake terms v13 and full divine-promise ending.

Svarc complete printed pages 4,12–16,18–19 visually inspected: serious speech-ellipsis proposal, syntactically possible current POB-type construal, incompatible damaged-sentence reconstructions and Pajunen contrary case correctly attributed through this study.

Guerra printed26,170,203–204 visually inspected: exorcism versus salvation-oracle classification, uncertain composition count, partially reconstructed response, and unresolved prophylactic/threat-specific function accurately reported.
substantive_review: The David title is supplied; Haomer and tishkon are outside brackets in consulted transcription; the kindness expansion remains partly restored and the v6 clause transposition is material.
Verse9 [qr]at is not a wholly preserved speech verb; refuge and following verb are damaged, suffix disputed, and a hybrid with MT must not be called a preserved 11Q11 reading.

Verse11 ways lies in restoration and cannot prove a preserved omission of all. Verse13 first snake is unbracketed but second wholly supplied. Compressed ending and Amen response remain reconstruction-qualified.
Possible collection adaptation is a contrary explanation, not an automatic disqualification of individual ancient readings or partial Greek agreement.
